question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Sober
solution:
The correct answer is '**drunk**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word sober is used to denote 'not affected by alcohol; not drunk.' (सादगीपूर्ण; शराब से प्रभावित नहीं; पिए हुए नहीं है)
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to '**sober**' is 'drunk'.
 
• 'Drunk' is to be affected by alcohol to the extent of losing control of one's faculties or behavior. (शर
